reviews.text: I've been taking my dog ​​Pepa to them for years and I'm delighted. She's had several procedures with Daniel and everything has gone very well; he's the best! I'm so grateful; they always treat me wonderfully, they're very experienced and attentive, highly recommended! ☺️

I wanted to thank the entire clinic team for their excellent care. I have three cats, and they've always helped me with every problem I've had. I highly recommend them; I've trusted them for years and will definitely continue to do so.

I live in Castellar, and I have to say that Georgina's care is very good, but the service offered by the company falls far short in this town. They're only open in the afternoons, and closed on Thursdays, August, and September. The waits are very long because they only have one person at the clinic. I'm very dissatisfied with this.
As always, great! 😃
Very good service and excellent attention from both Daniel and Georgina
We had to say goodbye to our big baby and he gave us the treatment we both deserved.
We make a 170 km trip there and back so they can visit our cats, and we do it because Daniel is a great professional, an expert in cats, and very patient with us.

I'm María Jesús, owner of King (a German Shepherd/Podenco mix), and although he's no longer with us, I can't express my deepest gratitude to Daniel Bolta, Georgina, and the incredibly kind receptionist for making every visit the best possible experience. In December 2025, he had his spleen removed due to a tumor, and then in March, he underwent emergency surgery. Both procedures went well, thanks to their amazing team. I've been so happy with them since the day he was a puppy, when they recommended a good food for his breed. Daniel, thank you for showing me photos of the surgeries and explaining every step in detail. Georgina, thank you for every smile and for taking such good care of King's paws. And to the receptionist, thank you for your constant empathy and kindness.

If I ever get another pet, you will once again be my trusted veterinary clinic, without a doubt.

Eternally grateful to all of you.

I've always taken my cats to Bolta. Their kindness and willingness to help are undeniable 🩷 They're super professional and clearly passionate about animals. I always recommend them. Thank you for treating Gumi and Wazowski with so much love 🩷 …
Excellent service, keep it up!!
Good clinic, they prioritize the well-being of the animals over making more money
Both Daniel and Georgina are wonderful, and their love for animals is evident. I take my cat there, and I'm delighted.
I've been going to this clinic for many years. I have complete confidence in them. They're friendly and communicate well. They treat our pets very well. Excellent.
Unprofessional and arrogant veterinarian

A small but welcoming clinic.

When I arrived, I didn't feel very comfortable as the situation wasn't the best... Then it seemed to improve, and after Georgina saw us, everything changed completely.
An exceptional professional in her field and a very, very empathetic, sincere, and caring veterinarian with a desire to improve any situation.
It's not necessary to spend excessively, even though it might seem that way because of the area it's located... We are very grateful and want to note that the results were noticeable in less than 24 hours.
Thank you 🫂

I've tried several places and this is definitely the best. They treat us with so much love. Georgina is a very sweet person, and all the girls there are wonderful ❣️ Daniel has always treated us very well too. They explain everything to us and always give our kittens lots of love. Plus, it's set up so the animals don't get stressed and are happy :)

It's a disgrace. Google Maps says they open at 10:30, but when I arrived, it was closed. They actually open at 11:00.

How can anyone trust a clinic that can't even update its basic hours on Google? Is it really so difficult to spend two minutes correcting it?

You arrive with your dog, in the heat, in a hurry—and you find the door locked. It's completely unacceptable.

I will never return to this clinic. If they can't manage something so simple, how can they possibly take good care of animals?

I went to the ophthalmologist for the first time for my cat. At our usual clinic, they couldn't diagnose him, and he wasn't getting better. At Bolta, they gave me the correct diagnosis, which was nothing like what I'd been told. It's been completely resolved and is now working perfectly. Thank you, Dr. Bolta. The care from the entire team is exceptional, and now it's my cat Mushu's clinic. It couldn't be better. Thank you.

They were absolutely fab, highly recommend them! I phoned them up in the morning as my little cockapoo girl had diarrhoea for a while. I tried everything (bland diet, probiotics powder) but it didn't seem to be better. They said they will find a time for her, just bring her in. Everyone was very nice and patient, the place is nice and clean. She got a good treatment (needed antibiotics) and they really cared about her (which for me is super important). They will be our vet from now, no question! Thank you again! Anikó and Fendi
My vet for almost 5 years. I'm delighted with the way he treats my cat.

Everyone in the clinic is helpful and very personable. I had to get health certificates for my pets to travel and with recent changes to the process it was quite stressful and challenging. However, I was kept up to date and when needed the staff went above and beyond to help make sure we were taken care of. I encourage any pet lover to trust this office! It is even more impressive that they are able to help in multiple languages.

I made an appointment at the last minute because my dog ​​had a terrible cough and was coughing up a lot of phlegm, and they saw her the same day without any problems.
The receptionist is incredibly friendly, and the vet who treated my dog ​​examined her patiently and was very clear about what was wrong and what she needed! We'll definitely be back if the opportunity arises!

Dr. Bolta and his staff were so wonderful to me and my dog Rosie.  They helped me get her paperwork together for her passport when I was going home to New York, and were always readily available whenever I needed them.  When the time came to put Rosie down due to old age, they were so caring and empathetic to her and to me.  They made the saddest experience gentle and calming.  I would highly recommend them to any dog lover.

Thank you Dr. Bolta & all the lovely ladies on staff

Warm regards,

Patricia Mahoney
Very good. My dog ​​loves them.

Fantastic service, professional staff, and the limping problem was solved with a quick operation.
We are very grateful.
Excellent, they always have Bravery pet food.
Everyone is very friendly, the facilities are nice and suitable for patients.
The best clinic. The doctors are very attentive and caring. I've never seen better treatment of animals. Thank you so much for your work 🙏🙏🙏🇺🇦 …
Excellent service, I hope it continues like this
My experience was terrible. We went with my dog ​​after 8:30 (they close around 8:45 pm) and they charged us 85 euros for an emergency. They only certified that the dog had died. This is for Daniel.
They treat the animals with so much love and respect. It's super important to me because I have a very fearful dog.
Excellent. The service is always impeccable. It's a pleasure to find people who love their work so much.
Excellent health care but, above all, extraordinary sensitivity, both towards the animal and its owners.
